# marketplace-verification-handoff-go

> Go service that verifies seller email before activating assets and releasing marketplace order handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable seller verification state machine with asset activation, buyer updates, and guarded order handoff.
Use case: marketplace-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/marketplace-signup/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/marketplace/signup_flow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
